text:
一週之內，輝達的中國問題從「空殼公司」升級成「疑似美人計」。

美國情報研判黃仁勳可能是中國間諜行動的目標，國會已經點名要他出席。

真假還沒定論，但重點不是八卦。

如果出口管制的破口可能是 CEO 本人，輝達說 Megaspeed 跟中國沒關係，光否認就不夠了。

用 15% 分潤換來的對中銷售許可，我賭撐不過這次聽證會。

40 of 41.

That's how many local ballot measures went for data center restrictions this midterm.

Voters aren't anti-AI. They're anti-paying for AI's electric bill.

Big Tech spent two years locking down chips and power contracts. It forgot the one input it can't buy: a yes vote from the county next door.

The next AI bottleneck won't be a fab. It'll be a zoning hearing.

記憶體荒已經燒到你手上了。

Oppo 傳出砍掉一支旗艦機，高階電子書閱讀器一口氣漲 40 到 50 美元。

連輝達都傳出找台積電研究 3D DRAM。台積電雖然否認，但訊號很清楚：DRAM 已經不是大宗商品，是戰略物資。

蘋果有定價權，漲價轉嫁就好；小品牌只能砍產品或吞毛利。

明年手機發表會最常見的升級，可能是「規格不變、價格上漲」。

The US approved H200 sales to an office in China with exposed wires and nobody inside.

A reporter walking through the door did a better audit than Commerce or Nvidia.

That's not export control. That's a toll booth with a 15% fee.

Add smuggling and cargo theft, and the real question isn't whether chips leak. It's how many.

Prediction: the revenue-share deal is the first casualty of Huang's trip to Congress.

Coding agents made writing code nearly free.

Nobody made reviewing it free.

GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Google and Cursor are now fighting over the same layer: what ships, what gets tested, what gets rolled back.

The IDE war is over. The merge-button war just started.

Bet: within 18 months, 'senior engineer' mostly means 'the person who signs off on agent PRs.'

Free Chinese open-weight models now hack almost as well as gated frontier models.

OpenAI rates GPT-6 Cyber's exploit skills as critical.

So the gate everyone argued about? It's open. And your distro's patch queue didn't get any faster.

Attackers don't need the best model anymore. They need the second-best one, free, on a laptop.

The next big breach won't need a zero-day. It'll walk through a patch that sat unshipped for weeks.

OpenAI wanted $30B at a $1.25T valuation. It got $11B.

That's not a funding round. That's a signal.

Ramp data says enterprise AI spend is flattening. Chatbots are adding ads and raising prices.

When the most hyped company on earth starts monetizing like a media business, the growth story is over and the margin story begins.

Anthropic's IPO will be the first real price check on the whole sector.

AI 產業以為最大的瓶頸是 GPU，再來是電。

結果是鄰居。

美國期中選舉 41 個資料中心相關公投，40 個都支持限制；阿姆斯特丹還有抗議者直接衝進微軟工地。

蓋資料中心要拿地、拿電、拿許可，每一關背後都是選票。

台灣也在搶 AI 資料中心，但我們的電價跟供電穩定度，經得起同樣的民意檢驗嗎？

AI 寫 code 變便宜之後，真正變貴的是什麼？

是 review。

以前一天收幾個 PR，現在 agent 一小時就能丟你幾十個。看不完，就只能按 approve，然後祈禱 rollback 夠快。

AWS 說別再當 agent 的保母，但少盯場只是把工作從盯 agent 換成稽核 agent。

接下來最搶手的工程師，不是最會下 prompt 的，是敢對 merge 負責的。

An agent deleted a syllabus. Another leaked identity data.

Neither went rogue. They did exactly what their permissions allowed.

That's the uncomfortable part: agent safety is mostly a plumbing problem, not an alignment problem. File access, credentials, tool scopes.

Palo Alto reportedly offering $500M for Clutch tells you where the money is going.

Next year's hottest security category: identity management for things that aren't people.

Anthropic 一邊準備 IPO，一邊被報告指出正用 AI 自動化 AI 研發，進步速度翻倍。

同一時間，OpenAI 目標募 300 億美元，只募到 110 億。

投資人現在問的不是「AI 多強」，而是「什麼時候賺錢」。

「AI 自我改進」聽起來是終極護城河，也是最難驗證的說法。

Anthropic 的公開說明書，會是第一份必須拿證據回答這題的文件。

業界在吵 AI 網路戰，攻擊者卻用預設密碼讓儲血室升溫。

AI 讓攻擊變強是真的，但很多受害者根本撐不到 AI 出場那一步。

密碼沒改、韌體沒更新、設備直接掛在網路上。

資安廠商的簡報裡全是 AI，客戶冰箱的密碼還是 admin。

你們公司連網的設備總共幾台，現在有人答得出來嗎？

給 AI agent 檔案權限、帳密、工具存取，然後期待它「自己小心一點」？

這不叫護欄，這叫許願。

刪掉教學大綱、外洩身分資料，這些事故都不是 AI 叛變，是權限給太大。

Palo Alto 傳出開價 5 億美元買 Clutch，agent 資安已經自成一個市場。

台灣企業還在問要不要導入 agent，更該先問的是：導入之後，誰負責把權限收回來？

AI didn't just eat the GPUs. It ate your phone's RAM.

Oppo reportedly cancelled a flagship. Premium e-readers jumped $40 to $50.

Apple will pass the cost on and keep its margins. Smaller brands will cut models or eat the loss.

Memory shortages don't hurt everyone equally. They consolidate markets.

By the end of 2027, mid-range Android will have fewer brands and higher prices.

40 out of 41.

That's how many local ballot measures voters backed to restrict data centers.

More than $400 million in tech-backed campaign money couldn't change that.

Everyone kept watching chips and power grids as AI's limit. The real limit turned out to be a zoning board and a few thousand annoyed neighbors.

My bet: within two years, buying local consent costs more than buying the land.

黃仁勳被中國間諜盯上的新聞很聳動，但真正該緊張的是另一件事。

一個美方核准購買 H200 的買家，地址查下去是一間空辦公室。

間諜案考驗的是一個人，空辦公室考驗的卻是整套出口管制。

連買家是不是真的存在都沒確認，那管制到底擋住了誰？

我猜接下來華府會把審查責任推到輝達頭上，台灣供應鏈的客戶查核壓力也會一起上來。

Forget the honeypot headline for a second.

A US-approved buyer for H200s turned out to be an empty office. That's not espionage. That's paperwork nobody checked.

Export controls are only as strong as the checks behind each license.

Last month, Nvidia saying Megaspeed has no China ties was enough. Next month it won't be.

Prediction: within a year, chipmakers become legally responsible for checking who actually ends up with their chips.

AI 一秒推 7,200 次 code，你的 reviewer 還在看第一個 PR。

寫程式已經不是瓶頸了，審查、測試、出事能不能 rollback 才是。

GitHub、GitLab、Cursor、Google 都在把平台改成以 agent 為中心，不是沒有原因。

沒有護欄會怎樣？已經有 agent 直接把整份課綱刪掉了。

接下來兩年最搶手的工程師，不是寫最快的那個，而是敢為 merge 負責的那個。

AI 泡沫沒有破，是開始被查帳了。

OpenAI 目標募 300 億美元，最後只募到 110 億。

Ramp 數據顯示企業 AI 支出開始持平，但 token 用量還在漲。
用得更多，付的錢卻沒變多，這才是重點。

投資人不再為成長故事買單，要看變現，所以聊天機器人開始放廣告。

Anthropic 偏偏這時候 IPO，會被打折賣，還是成為第一個交出漂亮成績單的 AI 實驗室？

AI 產業花了好幾年遊說華府，結果輸在密西根的地方投票。

41 個地方公投，有 40 個支持限制資料中心。

科技業砸了超過 4 億美元的競選經費，還是沒換到鄰居點頭。

台灣也別以為事不關己。
用電、用水、噪音，這些問題在桃園、在台南一樣會被拿出來問。

下一個卡住 AI 的，可能不是 GPU 交期，是里民大會。

Writing code is now the cheap part.

The cost has moved to whoever owns the merge button.

Agents open more PRs in an hour than a team can properly review in a week. So teams quietly start rubber-stamping, and the human in the loop becomes a human somewhere near the loop.

The next big dev tools company won't sell a better code generator. It'll sell a better "no."

Which senior engineer on your team is about to approve PRs full-time?

Gated AI hacking models had about a seven-month head start. It's gone.

Free Chinese models now nearly match them at hacking. OpenAI rates GPT-6 Cyber's exploit skills as critical.

But finding bugs isn't the scary part. Fixing them is. Linux distros already can't ship patches as fast as bugs get found.

When finding bugs is free and patching is slow, attackers win on math alone.

2027 is the year patch speed becomes a board-level metric.

Token usage: up.
Enterprise AI spend: flat.

Those two lines are the whole AI business model problem.

Customers use more AI and pay the same. Price cuts are eating the growth.

So the labs reach for the oldest revenue model on the internet: ads.

When your chatbot starts recommending products, that's not a new feature. It's a slide from the investor deck.

Anthropic's IPO will be priced on this reality, not the hype.

AI 資料中心把記憶體吃光，帳單最後寄到你家。

手機機種被砍、電子書閱讀器漲價，自組 PC 快變成有錢人的嗜好。

Apple 有定價權，漲價你還是會買。二線品牌沒有，只能砍規格或直接退場。

台灣記憶體廠這波賺翻，下游組裝和通路卻會很痛。

明年的中階手機，8GB RAM 搞不好又變回「旗艦配置」。

業界忙著談 AI 網路戰，攻擊者卻用預設密碼讓儲血室升溫。

AI 確實讓找漏洞變便宜了，但多數受害者根本不是被頂級模型打穿的，而是門本來就沒鎖。

網路上還有幾百個自主駭客工具就這樣曝露著，誰都能撿來用。

你公司的 IoT 設備，有幾台還在用出廠密碼？

下一次大規模事件，十之八九不是 AI 打進來的，是 admin/admin。

The Cybertruck is dead, and the lesson is simple: preorders are not demand.

Refundable $100 deposits bought headlines, not buyers.

Now its factory space goes to robotaxis that haven't shipped yet. Tesla is trading one unproven bet for another.

The EV that wins the next five years is a cheap, small hatchback, not a stainless-steel wedge.

Who builds it for the US market first: Tesla, Detroit, or whoever gets past the tariffs on BYD?

Cybertruck 停產，最好的教訓就一句：預購量不等於需求量。

100 美元的可退訂金，換來的是新聞版面，不是買家。

更妙的是，騰出來的產線要給還沒上路的 Robotaxi。
拿一個沒驗證過的賭注，換另一個沒驗證過的賭注。

電動車市場要的是便宜、小台、好停車，比亞迪早就懂了。

我猜 Tesla 下一台真正賣爆的車，會長得很無聊。

AI didn't just eat the GPUs. It's eating the RAM in your next phone.

Data centers are absorbing so much memory that phones are getting canceled, e-readers are getting pricier, and building a PC is turning into a luxury hobby.

Apple can pass the cost along. Everyone else shrinks.

The weird result: AI makes consumer hardware less competitive, not more.

Prediction: in 2027, base models quietly get worse specs at the same price.

兩家獲准買 Nvidia 禁售晶片的中國公司，記者照地址找上門，辦公室是空的。

連記者走一趟就能戳破的審查，到底審了什麼？

華府想要對中強硬的名聲，又不想砍 Nvidia 的營收。空辦公室已經說明哪邊贏了。

下一個被發現的空殼公司，不會只有兩家。

64GB 配置的電腦少了 18%。

不是玩家不想要，是記憶體都被 GPU 叢集搬走了。

AI 熱潮正在對 PC 玩家收隱形稅，而且這筆稅不會出現在任何發票上。

明年想組電腦的人，16GB 起跳可能要重新變成「夠用」的標準。

Millions of people chasing Pokémon were scanning sidewalks for robots without knowing it.

World models will be won by whoever owns the most real-world footage.

And most of that footage came from people who never agreed to train anything.

The next privacy fight won't be about your face. It'll be about your street.

出口管制最弱的一環從來不是晶片，是審核表格。

只要文件寫得漂亮、地址查得到，誰在那邊辦公根本沒人去看。

台灣供應鏈要注意：華府哪天因為這種醜聞突然收緊，最先被要求加強查核的會是誰？

我賭 2027 年前一定會有「現場查核」條款。

《魔獸世界：Forever》上線用了 70,480 顆 CPU 核心、251 TB 記憶體。

跟 17 年前比，核心變少，記憶體卻多了兩倍以上。

算力早就不是難題，記憶體才是讓幾百萬人同時在線的真正成本。

記憶體價格又在漲，暴雪下一筆帳單會有多痛？

M6 MacBook Pro 多了一組神經網路引擎，價格多 200 美元。

多數人用起來感受得到嗎？很難。

現在蘋果最強的對手，是自家降價的 M5。

想換機的人，這波 M5 特價大概才是今年最理性的選擇。

The Cybertruck might be the most expensive lesson yet that reservations are not revenue.

The crowd cheering at the launch didn't show up at checkout.

A $100 refundable deposit measures excitement, not intent.

Every EV startup still pitching its preorder count should be asked one thing: how many converted?

Every AR game, dashcam, and doorbell camera is now a data asset for world models.

The moat isn't the model architecture. Those leak in six months.

The moat is footage you can't buy anymore because the users already gave it away for free.

Watch for the first lawsuit claiming a game was secretly a mapping operation.

Raise the price $200 in summer. Cut it $200 in November. Get a "lowest price" headline.

That's the M5 MacBook Air right now.

The RAM shortage didn't just raise prices. It reset what a "deal" means.

By Black Friday, the original MSRP will be marketed as a doorbuster.

Robots were supposed to change war in the open. Drones in the sky, machines on the field.

Instead, Ukraine is sending them into underground gas pipelines.

The real use case for military robots is simple: the place no soldier wants to enter first.

The next wave won't be bigger robots. It'll be smaller ones.

關掉分頁，AI 代理還在幫你工作。聽起來很美。

直到兩個代理互相覆蓋對方的成果。

多代理產品的勝負不在模型多聰明，在協調做得好不好。

明年最搶手的不是會寫 prompt 的人，是會設計代理分工的人。

Peak Design owned the camera strap for a decade. Everyone copied their anchor system.

Now Wandrd shows up with magnets.

Being the standard doesn't protect you once someone ships a better feel in the hand.

Peak Design has maybe one product cycle to answer before "magnetic" becomes the default.

A pocket-sized receiver can intercept Russian drone video from six miles away.

And Ukraine's own adviser says it could be obsolete as soon as Russia changes bands.

Drone warfare now runs on product cycles measured in months.

Defense procurement still runs on cycles measured in years. Only one of those survives.

Linux 7.5 deleted 800 lines of Pentium-era MMX code and replaced them with 12.

Nobody throws a launch party for removing code.

But that's how a 35-year-old kernel stays fast while most software gets slower every year.

The best engineers on your team are probably the ones with negative line counts.

Accessory markets look sleepy until they don't.

One small mechanical change, like a magnet instead of a clip, and a ten-year leader suddenly looks dated.

The lesson for every incumbent: your copycats aren't the threat. The company that skips your design entirely is.

買 AI 程式工具授權，就像辦健身房會員。

刷卡那天最有動力，一個月後沒人去。

Docusign 在各團隊安插 75 位推動者，比任何強制命令都有效。

你們公司買了多少授權，又有幾個人真的每天在用？說真的，大部分老闆不敢查。

黃仁勳的外遇對象疑似是中國間諜，大家都在聊八卦。

但真正該問的是：華府為什麼等了一年才出手？

全世界最戰略性的晶片公司，執行長身邊可能出現反情報漏洞，董事會跟國會卻像在追劇。

Nvidia 沒有明顯的接班人，這才是最可怕的地方。

我賭董事會調查結束前，Nvidia 會先端出一份接班計畫。

Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld puts Jensen Huang's odds of keeping his job at 50-50.

That number isn't really about the affair. It's about succession.

Apple had Cook waiting behind Jobs. Nvidia has Jensen, and then a blank org chart.

When one person is the whole strategy, a personal scandal becomes a supply-chain risk.

The first casualty here won't be Huang. It'll be the 'founder forever' premium baked into every AI stock.

AI 代理一天可以往 repo 丟幾十個 PR，你的團隊一天審得完幾個？

寫程式已經不值錢了。瓶頸早就移到審查、治理，還有出事時能不能一鍵 rollback。

Goldman 撤掉 Claude Code、AI 代理亂刪檔案，問題都不是模型不夠聰明，是護欄沒裝好。

接下來最搶手的工程師，不是寫最快的那個，是最敢說「這個不能 merge」的那個。

Data center restrictions passed in 40 of 41 ballot measures this midterm cycle.

That's not a backlash. That's a mandate.

Big Tech spent two years worrying about GPUs and power. Turns out the scarcest input is a 'yes' from the people living next to the substation.

You can buy chips. You can't buy a zoning board's mood.

The next gigawatt goes to whoever offers towns the biggest electricity-bill rebate.

OpenAI 目標募 300 億美元，最後只拿到 110 億，1.25 兆的估值也比預期低。

這不是泡沫破掉，是模型開始賣不到好價錢。

Ramp 的數據很直白：企業的 token 用量一直漲，AI 支出卻持平。

推論越便宜，用戶越爽，實驗室的營收故事就越難講。

Anthropic 偏偏這時候要 IPO。

誰先承認自己是水電公司而不是軟體公司，誰就活得比較久。

Token usage up. Enterprise AI spend flat.

That's the whole story in six words.

Cheaper inference is great for customers and terrible for anyone valued like a software monopoly. OpenAI asked for $30B and walked away with $11B.

The market just priced frontier models like electricity.

Anthropic's IPO roadshow will get one question on repeat: what's your margin when the price per token keeps falling?

Amazon blocked Meta's Muse from shopping its site. Then launched its own shopping agent.

That's the entire agent war in two moves.

Nobody is really fighting over the best model. They're fighting over who stands between you and the checkout button.

If your agent shops on Amazon, Amazon wants to be your agent.

By next holiday season, 'which agents can buy here' becomes the new 'which cards do you accept.'

美國期中選舉，41 個限制資料中心的公投過了 40 個。阿姆斯特丹還有人上街暴力抗議。

台灣別以為事不關己。

我們自己電都快不夠用，AI 機房要搶電、搶水、搶土地，誰願意蓋在自己家旁邊？

晶片可以靠台積電，民意沒人能代工。

下一場地方選舉，「你家附近要不要蓋 AI 機房」絕對會變成辯論題。

GitHub, GitLab, Cursor and Google all shipped review and governance tools for AI agents within weeks of each other. Not a coincidence.

The coding model race is basically settled. The guardrail race just started.

Goldman pulling Claude Code wasn't about code quality. It was about who's accountable when an agent deletes the wrong folder.

The next dev tools unicorn sells an undo button, not a smarter autocomplete.

Free Chinese models now hack almost as well as gated frontier models. The gap closed in seven months.

Meanwhile, hundreds of autonomous AI hacking tools sit exposed online, and defenders are still running patch cycles measured in weeks.

Gating the model was the plan. It isn't anymore.

Palo Alto reportedly paying $500M for Clutch tells you where the money thinks the next breach starts: inside your own agents.

車廠花幾百萬強化 ECU，管理後台卻掛在一個下午就翻得出來的子網域上。

現在再加上 AI：以前資深駭客要花一週找的洞，自動化工具一個晚上就掃完。

攻擊方的成本在崩盤，防守方的修補還在跑簽核流程。

你的車鑰匙早就不在你口袋裡，在別人家的 API 上。

下一起大規模汽車資安事件，我賭不是人寫的，是 AI 代理自己跑出來的。

Meta、Amazon、Apple、Google、Perplexity、Airbnb，全部都在搶「幫你買東西的 AI 代理」。

但瀏覽器代理最關鍵的功能不是自主，是它懂得停下來說「換你了」。

DeepSeek Harness 新版讓代理自己開瀏覽器，真正值得看的是：它什麼時候把方向盤還給你。

誰把暫停鍵設計得最好，誰才拿得到使用者的信用卡。

AI data centers are eating the world's DRAM, and your next laptop is paying for it.

64GB PC builds are shrinking. E-readers got pricier. Oppo's Find X10 Ultra reportedly got killed outright.

WoW: Forever just launched on 251TB of RAM. Compute stopped being the hard part years ago. Memory is the tax now.

Prediction: 2027 flagships ship with less RAM than 2026's, and marketing calls it 'efficiency.'

記憶體荒來了。

AI 資料中心把 DRAM 吸光，64GB 的電腦越來越難組，電子書閱讀器漲價，Oppo Find X10 Ultra 傳出直接被砍。

以前是挖礦搶顯卡，現在是 AI 搶記憶體。

差別在於：這次不會那麼快退燒。

想組電腦的人，你現在看到的記憶體價格，很可能是未來兩年最便宜的。

黃仁勳的私生活，現在變成台灣供應鏈的風險了。

Nvidia 這幾年在華府一直說：賣晶片給中國是生意，不是國安問題。

執行長被傳和疑似中國情報人員有私交，還被叫去國會說明，這套說法就很難再講下去。

對台積電、廣達、緯創來說，最可怕的不是醜聞本身，而是華府趁機把降規版晶片也一起封掉。

我賭明年第一季前，對中出口管制只會更緊，不會更鬆。

You don't hire a sex-scandal PR firm to polish a philanthropy announcement.

Nvidia's whole pitch against export controls is basically "trust us, the chips stay where they should."

Now its CEO is headed to Congress over an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and there's a $4.8B customer with alleged spy-agency ties in the story too.

The lobbying shop just lost its best argument. The board may be next to hear about it.

Anthropic just paid $3.4B to skip a six-year waitlist for gas turbines.

Meanwhile, a bee conservation group and a motorcycle club teamed up to fight a Google data center.

AI's real bottlenecks aren't chips anymore. They're megawatts and permission.

The midterms made the second one official.

The next AI lab to win may simply be the one with the best zoning lawyers.

美國 AI 業者還在搶燃氣渦輪機的排隊位置，中國已經在一年內蓋好 120MW，成本只有五分之一，而且主要用自家風電。

出口管制擋得住晶片，擋不住電廠。

台灣的處境更尷尬：晶片是我們做的，最缺的卻是電。

AI 的天花板從算力換成電力以後，台灣靠「什麼都造得出來」還能撐多久？

手機廠開始把報廢手機上的記憶體熔下來，再焊到新機上。

這不是環保，是 AI 資料中心把 DRAM 吃光之後的求生手段。

先遭殃的是平價機：漲價、砍規格，甚至直接停產。

明年你買的「中階機」，可能要付今年旗艦機的價錢，規格還退步。

想換手機的人，年底這波可能是最後一次便宜買。

AI 寫一支 PR 只要幾分鐘，人看完卻要半天。

瓶頸早就不在寫程式，而在審查、驗證，還有出事時能不能退回去。

Goldman Sachs 把 Claude Code 從交易員手上收回，不是因為它寫不出來，而是沒人敢保證它寫的是對的。

未來三年最值錢的工程能力，可能就是一鍵 rollback。

Someone wrote a bash script that emails Sam Altman whenever your RAM usage drops below 90%.

It's a joke. It's also the sharpest critique of the AI memory grab so far.

Phones are getting price hikes, e-readers are getting cancelled, and makers are re-soldering memory pulled off dead devices.

When developers start turning your supply chain into a meme, you've already lost the PR war. Budget phones are paying first. Mid-range is next.

AI agents now write code faster than any team can review it.

That flips the job. Writing code is cheap. Proving it's safe is expensive.

Goldman pulling Claude Code from its traders isn't an anti-AI move. They ran out of review capacity.

The next billion-dollar dev tool won't write code. It'll tell you which 3% of the AI's code you actually need to read.

OpenAI set out to raise $30B. It got $11B.

At a $1.25T valuation, that isn't a vote of confidence. It's investors politely saying "we'll take a smaller slice, thanks."

Anthropic is heading toward an IPO, and public markets will ask what private rounds skipped: where's the margin?

My bet: 2027's AI darling won't be a trillion-dollar lab. It'll be a 40-person startup doing $100M ARR.

你買頭帶是想睡得好一點，它卻可能一直在幫大腦 AI 模型蒐集訓練資料。

廠商說資料已經「去識別化」，但腦波本身就是生物特徵，光靠它就認得出你。

密碼外洩可以改，腦波外洩要怎麼改？

下一波被立法盯上的不會是聊天機器人，而是你床頭那些穿戴裝置。

OpenAI 想募 300 億美元，最後只拿到 110 億，連目標的一半都不到。

估值 1.25 兆，錢卻收不滿，這不是市場有信心，是投資人開始算數學了。

真正值得看的是那些 30 人就做到上億營收的 AI 新創，它們會重新定義什麼叫「有效率」。

泡沫不會一夜破掉，但會先從「募不滿」開始漏氣。

AI 助理的免費試吃期要結束了。

Apple 急著把 Siri 做成代理式助理，Apple、Samsung、Meta 也都在測付費方案和用量包。

問題是 Siri 連設鬧鐘都會聽錯，現在要你付費讓它幫你訂機票？

可靠度還沒到，計量收費就先來了。

我猜明年最常見的客訴會是：「這個月額度用完，Siri 罷工了。」

Meta estimating your age with AI. A sleep headband training models on your brainwaves. Your Mac quietly sorting your family into categories.

"On-device" and "anonymized" were supposed to mean you're safe. Now they're the loopholes.

Consent buried in a firmware update isn't consent.

Expect the first major brain-data privacy lawsuit within 12 months, and expect the defense to be "it was de-identified."

Consumer AI is turning into a utility bill.

Paid tiers, usage packs, cheap agent models for the free plan. Apple, Samsung and Meta are all testing how much you'll pay before you notice.

The catch: metering only works when the product works. Nobody tops up their data plan for a connection that drops half the time.

The first company to cap free AI features before fixing reliability is going to get crushed in reviews.

Uber isn't really getting into parking.

It's grabbing curb and garage access now, before robotaxis need somewhere to sleep at night.

The 10% cashback is just there to keep you inside Uber One until then.

In five years, the most valuable thing Uber owns might not be its app. It might be the parking spots.
